Mersen.why: Supplies graphite solutions used in SiC crystal growth and in silicon semiconductor manufacturing (ion implantation), under a long-term contract with a SiC customer; SiC semiconductor sales were around EUR 25 million in H1 2026, and data-center electrical protection is a second AI-linked business.
Mersen.evidence: Mersen Q2 FY2026 (07-30-2026), CFO: 'Sales in SiC, it's around EUR 25 million in the first half'; 'the renegotiation of long-term contract with our silicon carbide customer in H1 2025.'

players.product: isostatic graphite, carbon insulation and coated graphite parts for SiC crystal growth and epitaxy

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results: sales EUR 611 million, organic growth +3.9% (improving in Q2 versus Q1), including a negative currency impact of EUR 22 million; EBITDA EUR 97.4 million (15.9% of sales); operating income before non-recurring items EUR 56.5 million (9.2%); at constant exchange rates operating income +2% and EBITDA almost +4%; net income +5% (+10% at constant rates). Growth led by North America (electrical distribution for data centers, aeronautics, wind) and Asia-Pacific (+7.6% organic); Europe slightly down on weak chemicals. Electrical Power gained 280 basis points of EBITDA margin; CEO: Electrical Power's EBIT margin level is sustainable. Net debt EUR 400 million, leverage ratio 2.3.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 sales EUR 611 million (+3.9% organic); EBITDA EUR 97.4 million (15.9%); operating income EUR 56.5 million (9.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: CFO: SiC semiconductor sales were around EUR 25 million in H1 and remain, as expected, at a low level; volumes increased but were offset by the non-recurrence of the positive effect of the H1 2025 renegotiation of the long-term contract with its silicon carbide customer (about 100 basis points of group margin); part of the SiC customer's advance payments was reimbursed, with EUR 20 million-EUR 30 million still to be repaid over several years. CFO: no change expected in SiC semiconductors in H2. CEO: the move to 800 volt DC data-center architecture should create additional opportunities for the Advanced Materials segment as SiC takes over part of that architecture.
quarterly_data.figure: SiC sales ~EUR 25 million in H1; EUR 20 million-EUR 30 million of advances still to repay

quarterly_data.signal: Silicon semiconductors: revenue exceeded EUR 30 million in H1 2026, strong double-digit growth, and is expected at more than EUR 60 million for the full year. CEO: Mersen's graphite solutions are used in several critical stages of semiconductor manufacturing, particularly ion implantation, with long-standing relationships with the leading semiconductor manufacturers; data centers and AI are key drivers of the momentum.
quarterly_data.figure: silicon semiconductor revenue >EUR 30 million in H1; >EUR 60 million expected for 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Data centers: revenue above EUR 20 million in H1 2026 and expected to exceed EUR 40 million for the full year, roughly twice the 2025 level, from fuses and electrical protection plus power management inside data centers; North America is growing fastest, with more Asian deliveries to customers whose systems go to North America. CEO: the 800 volt DC architecture should have a positive impact on some product ranges, 'times two, times four'.
quarterly_data.figure: data-center revenue >EUR 20 million in H1; >EUR 40 million expected for 2026

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 guidance raised: organic growth 4%-6% (upper range of the initial guidance); EBITDA margin before non-recurring items 16%-16.5%; operating margin before non-recurring items 9%-9.5% (initially 8%-9%); industrial capex EUR 80 million-EUR 90 million (initially EUR 90 million-EUR 100 million). H2 growth expected stronger than H1 on price and volume in Electrical Power; Q2 price increase around 3% with further increases in H2; CFO: free cash flow above 2025's EUR 6 million is 'a fair assumption'. CEO confirmed the 2029 roadmap of sales around EUR 1.7 billion and operating margin of 12% plus or minus 50 basis points.
quarterly_data.figure: organic growth 4%-6%; EBITDA margin 16%-16.5%; operating margin 9%-9.5%; capex EUR 80 million-EUR 90 million

quarterly_data.signal: Other businesses: EV sales around EUR 15 million in H1, with fuse selections by Ford and Leapmotor, a CATL nomination at the end of 2025, and busbar deliveries to ACC at about three times last year's volume; chemicals sales around EUR 45 million in H1, down 15%-20%; solar shows no recovery. SMRs: Mersen is the only integrated isostatic graphite producer in the US, supplies nuclear-grade graphite to Terra Innovatum's prototype, has prototype orders from TerraPower and also works with X-energy, with very low sales mostly in 2027 and a ramp expected between 2028 and 2030. A Defense Logistics Agency contract of close to $10 million is being delivered.
quarterly_data.figure: EV sales ~EUR 15 million in H1; chemicals ~EUR 45 million (-15% to -20%); DLA contract close to $10 million
